items.title_en: Gold steady in global markets on Tuesday morning
items.body_en: Spot gold held steady at $4,141.81 an ounce on Tuesday morning. US December gold futures rose 0.3% to $4,169.10. A firm dollar and 10- and 30-year US Treasury yields hitting 24-year highs on Monday capped gold's rise. Friday's weak US jobs data has eased expectations of an October rate hike. Spot silver was flat at $61.04 an ounce.

items.title_en: Gold slips after firm start on MCX, silver gains
items.body_en: On Monday morning MCX December gold opened at Rs 1,51,197 (previous close Rs 1,50,390) but then fell Rs 965 to about Rs 1,49,425 per 10 grams. December silver futures rose Rs 923 to about Rs 2,26,800 per kg. Weak US jobs data lifted both metals in global markets.
